### The Region and the World
**Exiled opposition leader tries to enter Venezuela as Rodriguez meets Trump in US: South China Morning Post**
Maria Corina Machado was blocked from returning to Venezuela as Rodriguez met Trump in the United States. The South China Morning Post described the New York talks as the first encounter since Nicolas Maduro's capture.
Source: https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas

### Both Sides: Foreign action against organized crime
At the UN General Assembly, the question is how far governments outside a country should go in fighting organized crime in the region, and who decides. Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva told the assembly that Brazil needs cooperation, not intervention. He rejected any foreign role in combating organized crime.
